name: BTCM App
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 0.84). Replaced keyword guess "input-validation".
rootCause: BTCM App’s April 22, 2025 Arbitrum incident is anchored by one independently checked successful transaction, but the incident-time code and full loss total remain unverified. Public descriptions attribute the drain to an overPaper() withdrawal path and report later movement toward Ethereum. The available evidence confirms a successful Arbitrum call from 0xbf4fe9c88660d628e11702ef780376dd16495b16 to 0xdd4384a8c21fef787cc93c02b1c0d1efac6119c5 with ERC20 transfer activity, but it does not recover the incident-time contract code. Public descriptions attribute the drain to an overPaper() value-moving path with inadequate authorization, so the precise failing check remains unverified here.
